t: The Hager Sollysta WMSU83 13A unswitched fused spur is a robust electrical connection unit designed for safe power distribution to fixed appliances. Features a raised slim profile in white with white inserts and a secure screwed faceplate. Angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws and clearly marked terminals simplify wiring, accommodating up to 6mm² cables. Installation is straightforward, requiring a minimum 25mm back box.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
